deflection_zh: 這個問題很好，我們一起問爸爸媽媽好嗎？

5-6: 依家裡的信仰，用自己的話回答
說：每家的信仰不一樣，都值得尊重
不要批評別人拜的神或不拜神
問孩子：你是在哪裡聽到的？
7-8: 說明世界上有不同的宗教與信仰
信仰是人心裡的依靠，每個人不一定一樣
尊重有信仰的人，也尊重沒有信仰的人
不確定的問題，可以說我們一起找答案

what_not_to_say: 不要說「神不存在」或「拜拜都是假的」
不要用信仰嚇孩子，例如「不聽話會被罰」
不要拿不同宗教的人來比較好壞

sources.title: Parenting Resources, Activities, & Early Childhood Development Support - Sesame Workshop

author: claude-haiku

en.deflection: That's a wonderful question! Let's ask mom or dad together, okay?
triggers: why do people go to temple

5-6: Answer in your own words, based on your family's beliefs.
Say: every family believes differently, and each belief deserves respect.
Don't criticize other people's gods or people who have no faith.
Ask your child: where did you hear about that?
7-8: Explain that the world has many different religions and beliefs.
Faith is something people lean on, and not everyone believes the same.
Respect people who have faith, and people who do not.
For questions you can't answer, say we can find the answer together.

what_not_to_say: Don't say 'God doesn't exist' or 'praying is all fake'.
Don't use faith to scare, like 'you'll be punished if you're naughty'.
Don't rank people of different religions as good or bad.
